title: Brand Development Specialist
description:
**BRAND DEVELOPMENT SPECIALIST** 




  





**trueceil™ \|** 
 Built Above Standard
 



**Location:** 
 Kochi, Kerala
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 Architectural Products \| Building Materials \| Interior Systems
 



  





**About trueceil™** 




**trueceil™** 
 is an emerging architectural ceiling systems brand offering
 **design\-led, reliable metal ceiling solutions** 
 for commercial, institutional and architectural spaces.
 



 Our portfolio includes
 **metal ceiling tiles, lay\-in, clip\-in, open\-cell, baffles, linear ceilings and grid systems.** 




**As trueceil continues to grow, we are looking for a Brand Development Specialist** 
 to strengthen our presence across the architecture, interiors and construction industry.
 



 This is an opportunity to contribute directly to the
 **growth, visibility and market development of an emerging brand.** 




  





**The Role** 




 You will play a key role in developing trueceil's
 **brand presence, professional network and business opportunities.** 




**Working closely with management, you will identify new opportunities, build relationships with industry professionals, increase brand visibility and develop a strong project pipeline.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Brand Development
 


* Support trueceil's brand positioning and market development initiatives.
* Develop opportunities to increase brand awareness and professional visibility.
* Support product launches, exhibitions, events and marketing campaigns.
* Coordinate with creative teams on presentations, catalogues, samples and brand communication.



 Architectural \& Market Engagement
 


* Build relationships with architects, interior designers, consultants, contractors and project teams.
* Conduct product presentations, sample demonstrations and design discussions.
* Identify upcoming projects and opportunities for TRUECEIL products to be considered or specified.
* Develop and maintain a strong professional network.



 Project \& Business Development
 


* Identify new markets, customer segments and project opportunities.
* Track projects from design and specification through tender and execution.
* Coordinate with internal teams for samples, technical information and quotations.
* Develop qualified business opportunities and support their conversion into projects.



 Market Intelligence
 


* Monitor competitor products, pricing, positioning and market activity.
* Track industry trends and gather feedback from customers and professionals.
* Identify market gaps and opportunities and share insights with management.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for someone who is
 **proactive, commercially aware, articulate and relationship\-driven.** 



* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Confidence interacting with architects, designers, consultants and business professionals.
* Interest in architecture, interiors, construction or building products.
* Strong networking and relationship\-management abilities.
* Ability to understand technical products and communicate their value.
* Willingness to travel and work independently.
* Ability to take ownership and create opportunities.



**We Value People Who** 
 :
 



**Create opportunities. Build relationships. Think beyond the next sale. Take ownership.** 




  





**Experience** 




**2–5 years of relevant experience preferred.** 




**Experience in architectural products, building materials, interior products, ceiling systems, acoustics, construction or other B2B industries** 
 will be an advantage.
 



 Experience working with
 **architects, designers, consultants or contractors** 
 is particularly valuable.
 



  





**Why Join trueceil?** 




 trueceil is at an exciting stage of growth where
 **your work can directly influence the future of the brand.** 




**You will work closely with management and gain exposure to:** 




**Brand Development \| Market Strategy \| Architecture \& Design \| Business Development \| Project Development \| Product Marketing** 




**As trueceil grows, so will the opportunity for greater responsibility, ownership and career progression.** 




  





**Compensation** 




 Compensation will be based on relevant experience and capabilities \+ performance\-based incentives
 



  





**Build The Next Stage Of trueceil™** 




 If you want to
 **build relationships, develop markets and play a meaningful role in growing an architectural brand** 
 , we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**trueceil™** 




 Built Above Standard

title: Manager - Business Analysis
description:
**Job Title \- Manager – Business Analysis \- ACS Song**
**Management Level: Level 7, Manager**
**Location: Kochi**
**Must have skills: Techno\-functional BA lead with eCommerce experience, CPQ or Pricing; independent client\-facing consulting; consultative selling; and team leadership**
**Good to have skills: Experience across multiple commerce, CPQ or pricing platforms,s pre\-sales, estimation and solution\-shaping exposure**
**Experience: 10\-15 years of experience is required**
**Educational Qualification** 
 :
 **Graduation in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Commerce or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional certification is preferred**
**Job Summary**
 You will help clients translate business and user needs into digitally enabled eCommerce, CPQ and pricing solutions. The role requires a consultative techno\-functional Business Analyst Manager who can independently lead client\-facing engagements, shape solutions and proposals, connect business objectives with platform capabilities, and lead Business Analyst teams through clear requirements, delivery governance, backlog readiness and stakeholder alignment.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Lead the Business Analysis workstream across eCommerce, CPQ or Pricing delivery, with accountability for the BA strategy, team mobilization, requirements governance, quality standards and stakeholder alignment.
* Partner with client Product Owners, senior business sponsors, solution architects, sales and delivery leaders to shape scope, roadmap, commercial propositions and prioritization decisions.
* Lead executive and senior stakeholder workshops to frame business problems, define measurable outcomes, identify value levers and align on transformation and implementation approaches.
* Guide as\-is/to\-be process design, capability mapping, gap analysis, backlog strategy and release scoping across multiple functional areas.
* Direct, build and quality\-assure epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, functional specifications and decision records produced by the BA team.
* Identify solution options and make recommendations that balance business value, user experience, platform constraints, delivery risk and technical complexity.
* Own requirements traceability, change impact analysis and decision management across discovery, inception, construction, UAT and release.
* Lead cross\-functional governance and delivery forums involving client business users, product owners, sales, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, data/integration and programme management.
* Own resolution and executive escalation of complex functional, delivery and scope issues, driving timely decisions and clear accountability.
* Lead estimation, staffing, transition planning, pre\-sales/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, reusable assets and practice/capability development as required.
* Operate as the Business Analysis Manager who independently represents the BA function to client executives, account leadership and delivery leadership.
* Own complex and ambiguous eCommerce problems, mobilize the right stakeholders and drive structured recommendations.
* Lead, coach and performance\-enable a team of Business Analysts; allocate work, review outputs, build capability and ensure consistency, quality and delivery readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders through consultative selling, value\-led storytelling, negotiation and clear recommendation of decision options.
* Contribute to account growth and delivery health by identifying opportunities, risks, dependencies, capability gaps and continuous improvement actions.
* Strong understanding of digital commerce capabilities including product discovery, product detail, cart, checkout, order capture, promotions, payment, inventory visibility, fulfilment and order status.
* Build trusted client relationships, identify follow\-on opportunities and collaborate with sales and solution teams to progress qualified opportunities.
* Be accountable for BA workstream plans, estimates, staffing needs, milestones, risks, dependencies and the quality of functional deliverables.
* Establish reusable methods, templates and quality gates, and contribute to hiring, mentoring and capability development for the Business Analysis practice.
* Strong techno\-functional understanding of APIs, webhooks, events, integrations, data flows, security, analytics and non\-functional requirements relevant to commerce, CPQ and pricing platforms.
* Ability to lead multiple capability areas across commerce journeys, product configuration, guided selling, quotation, approvals, pricing, promotions, order management, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs, lead fit\-gap analysis and guide business trade\-off decisions with client, architecture and delivery leaders.
* Ability to collaborate with product owners, experience designers, architects and engineering teams to convert experience and business objectives into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Business analysis leadership and requirements governance for complex digital commerce, CPQ or pricing programmes.
* Ability to lead multiple commerce capability areas across discovery, cart/checkout, order management, customer account, promotions, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess commerce platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs and guide business trade\-off decisions with architects and delivery leads.


 Executive workshop facilitation, consultative selling, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, negotiation and requirements elicitation.

title: Product Manager - Exposure Management
description:
**Role purpose:** 




  





 Do you want to help organisations find and fix their most critical exposures before attackers do? At Prevalent AI, our Exposure Management application sits on top of our Data Fabric platform as our flagship application — unifying asset, vulnerability, identity, and control data into a knowledge graph of interconnected security entities. Powered by agentic AI prioritization, it delivers contextual, actionable intelligence that shifts clients from reactive vulnerability management to proactive, pre\-emptive risk reduction aligned with Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM).
 



  





 As Product Manager for Exposure Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and growth of the Exposure Management application — from attack surface visibility and risk\-based prioritisation through to remediation workflows, attack path mapping and measurable exposure reduction. You will work closely with clients, go\-to\-market teams, and engineering to identify the highest\-value opportunities, sharpen the application’s differentiation, and unlock cross\-sell within existing accounts. You will balance near\-term delivery with long\-term vision — delighting clients today while contributing to a platform where clients create and bring their own agents. If you’re passionate about turning complex exposure data into decisions that matter — join us.
 



  





**Key accountabilities:** 




  





**Strategy \& Vision** 



* Define and own the product vision and roadmap for the Exposure Management application, ensuring alignment with client outcomes, business goals, and the evolving threat landscape.
* Guide the development of high\-level features, Epics, and use cases — grounded in real\-world security workflows and informed by AI\-powered knowledge graph insights.
* Leverage market intelligence, client feedback, and competitive analysis to prioritise the roadmap and identify opportunities for innovation across the CTEM lifecycle.
* Contribute to the portfolio\-level strategy for Data Fabric Applications, ensuring Exposure Management reinforces a coherent platform proposition.



  





**Client \& Market** 



* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Client Solutions teams to ensure the Exposure Management application remains client\-focused and keeps pace with the evolving market.
* Translate complex exposure and vulnerability management challenges into actionable, outcome\-driven product features that demonstrably reduce client risk.
* Identify pain points and innovation opportunities through deep client engagement and data analysis.
* Work closely with Sales and go\-to\-market teams to shorten deal cycles, strengthen sales tooling, and unlock cross\-sell opportunities within existing accounts.



  





**Engineering \& Delivery** 



* Partner with Engineering and Product Development teams to ensure the design and implementation of use cases aligns with client and market demands, whilst remaining deliverable and maintainable.
* Provide knowledge transfer and guidance to Data Analysts, Engineers, and Data Scientists — ensuring the broader development team understands the client challenges and security problems the applications address.



  





**Go\-to\-Market** 



* Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to inform the creation of product marketing material and support go\-to\-market execution.



  





**Leadership \& People Management** 



* Lead, manage, and develop a team of Product Owners, providing clear direction, regular feedback, and support for their professional growth.
* Set objectives for the Product Owner team that are aligned with the broader product strategy, and hold regular 1:1s and performance reviews.
* Foster a high\-performing team culture built on accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and agile ways of working.
* Champion agility, iterative learning, and innovation across product and engineering teams.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 




  





**Essential** 




**Product Management** 



* Proven experience in product management, with a track record of owning strategy, roadmap, and full lifecycle delivery of complex technology products.
* Deep understanding of agile development and end\-to\-end product delivery, with strong prioritisation skills focused on client value and business impact.
* Skilled at balancing immediate client needs with long\-term product vision, using data, market research, and competitive analysis to drive decisions.



**Cybersecurity Domain** 



* Strong understanding of threat and exposure management, including vulnerability management, attack surface management, identity security, and risk\-based prioritisation.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as CTEM, and a practical understanding of attack surfaces, attack paths, misconfigurations, control gaps, and shadow IT.
* Experience working with or alongside vulnerability management or security operations teams — understanding how practitioners assess, prioritise, and remediate exposures in practice Hands\-on familiarity with exposure management tooling — such as vulnerability scanners, EASM/CAASM platforms, attack path or exposure graph engines, and risk scoring approaches — including key operational pain points and workflow patterns.



**AI \& Data** 



* Demonstrable experience shipping AI\-powered products, with a working understanding of how ML models, LLMs, and AI\-driven insights are integrated into product experiences.
* Experience translating complex data and AI\-driven outputs into actionable, client\-focused product features that drive measurable security outcomes.



**Leadership \& Communication** 



* Experience leading and developing product teams, including line management of Product Owners.
* Confident communicator, adept at presenting to senior stakeholders and leadership.
* Proven ability to build strong relationships across cross\-functional teams including Engineering, Sales, and Client Solutions.



  





**Desirable** 



* Experience working with knowledge graph concepts and entity\-relationship data modelling — understanding how interconnected data can be used to surface contextual security intelligence.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks or AI\-assisted workflows in a security operations context.
* Experience building use cases on top of a shared data platform or data fabric architecture.
* Familiarity with vulnerability intelligence and scoring standards — such as CVSS, EPSS, and KEV — and how they inform risk\-based prioritisation.
* Experience working in or alongside a managed security service, with an understanding of how client\-facing delivery shapes product requirements.
* Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem or similar data platforms.



  





**Education:** 



* B.Tech in Computer Science, or a related field, Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration
* Certification in Product Management or Agile methodologies (e.g., PMI\-ACP, CSPO) is a plus

title: Product Architect
description:
**About KeyValue** 




  





 KeyValue is a premier global AI\-driven product development hub, dedicated to transforming ideas into scalable and impactful software products. With expertise across diverse industries, we deliver high\-quality solutions with the power of AI and automation. As an AI\-first organisation, we strive to push the boundaries of technology, offering accelerated, flexible and cost\-effective product development.
 



  





 We have ideated, conceived, strategized and built some of the globe’s most innovative Fintech, Payments, Financial Services, Digital Commerce, Madtech, Edtech, Socialtech, Logistics, High Technology, Blockchain, Crypto, NFT and Healthcare companies, helping them conceive, scale, pivot and enhance their businesses.
 



  





 KeyValue’s mission is to be the world’s most trusted product development hub – delivering high\-value outcomes for start\-ups \& scale\-ups – with a talented skilled team – in a thriving and inclusive culture.
 



 We're looking for a
 **Product Architect** 
 to own the technical direction of our products end to end from the first architecture decision to systems running reliably at scale. You'll set the technical bar, make the hard calls on architecture and technology and lead engineers through complex problems. Just as important: you'll be the person who spots the problem early
 *and* 
 brings the solution, working shoulder to shoulder with product, engineering and business teams.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Own product architecture from concept and technology choices all the way through to systems running in production at scale.
* Translate product and business requirements into clear technical designs covering system architecture, APIs, data models, integrations and infrastructure.
* Make and defend key architectural decisions while weighing performance, security, reliability, maintainability and cost.
* Stay hands\-on by contributing to critical design and coding decisions rather than just diagrams.
* Catch architectural risks and bottlenecks early and drive the fixes before they become blockers.
* Lead engineers through hard technical problems and keep architecture consistent across teams.
* Run architecture, design and code reviews and raise the engineering bar through best practices and mentoring.
* Evaluate AI, automation and emerging tech for real product use, focusing on signal rather than hype.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 6\+ years of experience in building and shipping software products, with strong hands\-on engineering depth.
* Hands\-on experience building AI/LLM\-enabled products or working with AI\-assisted development.
* Strong expertise in software architecture, system design, design patterns and data structures and algorithms.
* Proven experience with microservices, distributed systems, event\-driven and high\-availability architectures.
* Strong in one or more backend languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, Go, Scala, or Rust.
* Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases, API design across REST and GraphQL and system integrations.
* Hands\-on with AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud\-native patterns.
* Good grasp of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, testing and production reliability.
* A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into clear technical direction and getting a team to rally behind it.
* A sharp communicator who can explain trade\-offs to engineers, product and business teams alike.

With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. title: Microsoft-CRM Technical-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Senior Manager Specialized:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced MS CRM Technical Senior Manager to lead large\-scale Dynamics 365 CRM engagements, drive solution excellence, and contribute to business growth. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, ensuring successful delivery, stakeholder alignment, and expansion of CRM capabilities across accounts. You will play a key role in shaping solutions, mentoring teams, and driving business development initiatives within the Microsoft Business Applications ecosystem.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end design and delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions across complex programs.
* Architect scalable, high\-performance solutions aligned with business and technology strategies.
* Drive solution quality, governance, and best practices across implementations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define vision, roadmap, and transformation initiatives.
* Provide technical leadership across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to timelines and budgets.
* Mentor and guide teams, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* Support pre\-sales activities including solutioning, estimations, proposal development, and client presentations.
* Identify and drive business development opportunities, including account growth, pipeline creation, and cross\-sell of CRM and related capabilities.
* Build strong client relationships and act as a trusted advisor for CRM transformations.
* Ensure risk management, issue resolution, and proactive escalation across engagements.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, etc.) and Power Platform.
* Deep understanding of CRM architecture, customization, configuration, and extension capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience in integrations, data migration, and enterprise solution design.
* Proven leadership in managing large, distributed teams and complex programs.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to balance technical delivery with business priorities and growth objectives.
* Experience in Agile/DevOps methodologies and modern delivery practices.
* Strong analytical mindset with focus on quality, scalability, and performance.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
 The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:
   

  

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center


**What We Look For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Total Experience: 12\+ years
* Relevant Experience: 12\+ years
* Proven track record of delivering Dynamics 365 CRM programs at scale.
* Strong exposure to client\-facing roles, including pre\-sales and business development.
* Experience working in global delivery models and cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications are preferred.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:**

The role ensures these platforms provide reliable telemetry, actionable alerts, remote support capabilities and useful operational insights that improve service quality and the technology\-based office experience.

The role will guide platform selection and lifecycle decisions, establish support and governance models, drive integrations and automation, and measure the business value delivered by the portfolio.

* Prepare business cases, financial forecasts, investment recommendations and leadership updates for the product portfolio.

Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.

As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization.

* Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements.
* Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria.
* Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs.
* Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long\-term sustainability objectives.
* Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems.
* Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment.
* Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles.
* Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors.
* Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials.
* Support decision\-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development.
* Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance.
* Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end\-to\-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments.
* Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles.
* Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups.

* Demonstrates ownership, leadership, and a proactive approach to driving initiatives, managing stakeholders, and delivering business outcomes.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark, Brazil, the UK, and other SPS manufacturing locations as required.

**Job Summary:**
 The GDS Cyber Alliances Operations Specialist is a Manager\-level role within the GDS Alliances Partner Operations CoE, designed to strengthen how EY’s Cyber Alliance ecosystem is operationalized, governed, measured, and scaled. The role will serve as a trusted operations and insights partner to Cyber Alliance stakeholders by bringing together disciplined execution, partner program enablement, data\-led decision support, process excellence, and stakeholder orchestration. This position will help translate Cyber Alliance priorities into clear operating rhythms, actionable insights, improved adoption of partner programs, stronger pipeline and opportunity discipline, and measurable business impact across EY’s Cyber Alliance agenda.
   

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Act as a Manager\-level operations partner for Cyber Alliances, driving disciplined execution across governance cadences, stakeholder requests, delivery commitments, action tracking, issue resolution, and operational follow\-through.
* Convert Cyber Alliance data into actionable business insight by analyzing revenue, sales, pipeline, opportunity, partner program, certification, enablement, and stakeholder activity to highlight trends, risks, gaps, and growth opportunities.
* Build and enhance leadership\-ready dashboards, scorecards, insight packs, and executive views that move beyond reporting to provide clear interpretation, business context, recommended actions, and progress visibility.
* Strengthen Cyber Alliance pipeline and opportunity management by improving alliance tagging, data quality, pursuit tracking, account and prospect visibility, book\-of\-business hygiene, escalation management, and performance analysis.\\
* Lead operational enablement for partner programs, including tool and portal administration, access governance, certification and competency tracking, enablement participation, partner program requirements, and stakeholder support.
* Drive a strong continuous process improvement agenda across Cyber Alliance operations by simplifying processes, standardizing ways of working, improving controls, reducing manual effort, strengthening documentation, and proactively identifying opportunities for automation, workflow redesign, and Agentic AI\-enabled productivity, decision support, and service quality improvements.
* Maintain high\-quality operational knowledge assets, including process guides, partner program materials, reference repositories, enablement content, stakeholder trackers, and operating documentation that improve adoption and service consistency.
* Enable high\-impact Cyber Ecosystem and Alliance leadership forums through crisp agendas, insightful pre\-reads, decision\-oriented content, action logs, outcome documentation, and timely follow\-through.
* Support strategic engagements between EY Cyber leadership and alliance partners by coordinating briefing materials, stakeholder inputs, meeting logistics, priority topics, next steps, and decision records.
* Coordinate with Alliances Investment, Cyber Alliance, Legal, Finance, Compliance, and enablement teams to support Market Development Funds, investment requests, reimbursements, governance reviews, approval workflows, and process adherence.
* Partner with onshore Cyber Alliance Enablement contacts to advance strategic projects, operating model enhancements, reporting modernization, stakeholder communications, process transformation, and leadership\-driven priorities.
* Support global agreement localization, partner program obligations, operational reviews, and related documentation in partnership with Ecosystem Contracts and relevant internal teams. Manage stakeholder expectations with maturity by ensuring responsiveness, clarity, prioritization, escalation discipline, delivery transparency, and a consistently high\-quality service experience.


**Knowledge and Skill Requirements:**
* Strong understanding of alliance operations, cyber or technology services, partner ecosystems, opportunity life cycles, sales enablement, professional services operations, and GCC/shared services delivery models.
* High comfort with data\-led business operations, including the ability to interpret operational, pipeline, financial, certification, enablement, and stakeholder data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
* Ability to create compelling executive narratives, insight packs, dashboards, briefings, and business reviews that connect operational performance to strategic Cyber Alliance priorities.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint; Power BI, SQL, workflow automation, data visualization, process mining, AI\-enabled productivity tools, and practical use of Agentic AI or copilots for operational execution, insight generation, knowledge management, and productivity improvement will be strong differentiators.
* Strong continuous improvement orientation with experience in process simplification, operating model design, SOP development, documentation, controls, quality reviews, governance, and service delivery optimization.
* Working knowledge of Agentic AI concepts, responsible AI usage, prompt design, AI\-assisted workflow orchestration, automation opportunity identification, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, data quality considerations, and practical governance requirements for using AI in enterprise operations.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior Cyber Alliance stakeholders, Cyber practice leaders, alliance partner contacts, and cross\-functional teams confidently and credibly.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in a virtual, global, cross\-border environment with cultural sensitivity, responsiveness, collaboration discipline, and sound professional judgment.
* Strong problem\-solving, issue management, root cause analysis, research, prioritization, and mitigation skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and bring practical solutions to closure.
* Strong project and program management discipline, including planning, dependency management, execution tracking, governance reviews, stakeholder communication, and delivery across multiple priorities.
* Excellent English communication and business writing skills, with the ability to produce polished, structured, audience\-ready content with limited direction.
* Experience in alliance/partner programs, cyber services, technology ecosystems, sales operations, business operations, professional services, or GCC delivery will be highly valued.
* Working knowledge of EY, GDS, Alliances, Cyber, management information systems, independence considerations, and service delivery expectations would be advantageous.


**Job Requirements:**
**Academics:**
* MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent business/management qualification preferred.
* University degree required; background in technology, cyber, business, commerce, analytics, operations, or management will be advantageous.
* Certifications in project/program management, data visualization, process improvement, cyber fundamentals, automation, or alliance/partner management would be a strong advantage.


**Experience:**
* 12\+ years of relevant experience across alliance operations, cyber or technology services, business operations, sales/pipeline enablement, operational insights, stakeholder management, program coordination, process improvement, or GCC/shared services delivery.
* Prior experience operating with senior global stakeholders, supporting complex business reviews, managing operational cadences, and driving insight\-led service delivery in a matrixed environment will be highly valued.


**Working Hours:**
* This role requires strong alignment with US business hours to enable real\-time collaboration with Cyber Alliance stakeholders.
* Manila\-based team members are expected to support US Pacific Time, while India\-based team members are expected to support US Eastern/Central Time. The ability to consistently mirror the relevant US working day is a critical prerequisite for success in this role.
